onScreenGraphic.headline:
£4.2M Council Estate
Retrofit Approved
onScreenGraphic.body: Camden Council has authorised urgent insulation and heat-pump upgrades across 320 post-war social homes.

timeline.voiceoverText: Camden Council has approved a four point two million pound capital budget to retrofit three hundred and twenty council homes across three priority estates.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Camden Cabinet Housing Report · 18 Nov 2025 · Item 4
citations: Camden Cabinet Housing Retrofit Report, Para 1: '£4.2m capital allocation for 320 homes'

visualAsset.prompt: High-contrast 35mm monochrome documentary photography of London municipal architecture and streetscape, 9:16 vertical.

data.excerptPrefix: "The Authority hereby releases £4.2m in ring-fenced capital to
data.excerptSuffix: across Gospel Oak and Somers Town estates."

onScreenGraphic.headline:
Targeting Damp & Fuel
Poverty This Winter
onScreenGraphic.body: Works prioritise double-glazing, external wall insulation, and ventilation before spring.

timeline.voiceoverText: The resolution ring-fences capital to eliminate damp and mould, targeting estates in Gospel Oak and Somers Town before next spring.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Camden Housing Capital Programme · Section 2.4
citations: Section 2.4: 'ring-fenced capital to eliminate damp, mould and cold-bridging'

visualAsset.prompt: Authentic 35mm street-level documentary footage of London red bus and autumn street life, 24fps, 9:16 vertical.

cards.label: Heat Loss Reduction
cards.subtext: EPC Rating upgraded to Band B

onScreenGraphic.headline:
£480 Annual Bill Cut
Per Council Household
onScreenGraphic.body: Upgrading homes to Energy Performance Band B slashes heat loss by over sixty percent.

timeline.voiceoverText: Council engineers project the upgrades will cut tenant heating bills by four hundred and eighty pounds a year while reducing heat loss by sixty-two percent.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Camden Climate & Tenant Impact Assessment · Table 3
citations: Table 3: 'Projected £480 annual saving per household; 62% thermal loss reduction'

pillars.desc: Zero rent increases resulting from capital works

onScreenGraphic.headline:
Four-Phase Estate
Rollout Begins January
onScreenGraphic.body: Contractors will install glazing, heat pumps, and damp sensors with zero rent increases for tenants.

timeline.voiceoverText: Works begin in January across four phases, combining thermal glazing, communal heat pumps, and smart damp sensors with zero rent increases for tenants.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Camden Procurement & Tenant Charter · Para 5
citations: Para 5: 'Four-phase delivery starting January; tenant charter guarantees zero rent uplift'
